name: Exp_ColorZerolagX10MA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagX10MA custom indicator, which is a zero-lag composite moving average built from 10 differently-perioded smoothing lines with weighted factors. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable buy/sell open and close toggles. Position sizing and trade execution are handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple money management modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagX10MA自定义指标进行交易，该指标由10条不同周期的平滑均线和加权因子构成的零滞后复合均线。当指标向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并支持独立的买卖开平仓开关控制。仓位管理和交易执行通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，提供多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于零滞后X10均线(ColorZerolagX10MA)的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时触发买入信号，当指标值从上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时触发卖出信号。出场条件通过固定止损(StopLoss)和止盈(TakeProfit)参数控制，同时支持同方向信号反向平仓（买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于余额、基于净值、基于可用保证金、基于亏损后可用保证金。资金管理参数MM控制风险比例，默认0.1。策略使用10条不同周期(3至23)的平滑均线加权组合，通过Factor参数调节各均线权重，再用额外平滑层(Smooth)进一步过滤信号，显著降低滞后性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a trend following system based on the Zero-Lag X10 Moving Average (ColorZerolagX10MA). Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator turns upward (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell signal triggers when it turns downward (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions are controlled by fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, while the system also supports counter-direction closing (close sell positions on buy signals and vice versa). Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot (LOT), balance-based, equity-based, free margin-based, and loss-adjusted free margin-based. The money management parameter MM controls the risk ratio with a default of 0.1. The strategy combines 10 smoothing lines with different periods (3 to 23) weighted by Factor parameters, then applies an additional smoothing layer (Smooth) for signal filtering, significantly reducing lag compared to traditional moving averages.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额/净值等）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Net Margin/Net Balance/Fixed Lot)

parameters.name: Length1-10
parameters.description_en: Period lengths for each of the 10 MAs

parameters.name: Factor1-10
parameters.description_en: Weighting factors for each of the 10 MAs

pros: 零滞后均线设计通过10条均线加权组合有效降低了传统均线的延迟问题
买卖开平仓独立控制，策略灵活性高，可单独启用或禁用每个交易方向
支持5种仓位管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者需求
使用新K线检测(IsNewBar)避免同一根K线内重复交易
多层平滑过滤(10条均线+额外Smooth层)有效减少虚假信号
pros_en: The zero-lag moving average design effectively reduces traditional MA delay through a weighted combination of 10 smoothing lines
Independent buy/sell open/close controls provide high strategy flexibility, allowing each trade direction to be enabled or disabled individually
Supports 5 position sizing modes, accommodating traders with different risk preferences
Uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Multi-layer smoothing filtration (10 MAs + additional Smooth layer) effectively reduces false signals
cons: 参数过多(10个Length+10个Factor+其他)，优化空间大但极易过拟合历史数据
止损1000点、止盈2000点的固定值可能不适合所有品种和市场环境
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有滑点/点差过滤机制，在高点差品种上交易成本可能侵蚀利润
SignalBar默认为1意味着信号有一根K线的延迟，可能错过最佳入场时机
cons_en: Excessive parameters (10 Lengths + 10 Factors + others) create large optimization space prone to overfitting historical data
Fixed StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points may not suit all instruments and market conditions
Lacks trend filtering mechanism, potentially generating frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No spread/slippage filter, trading costs on high-spread instruments may erode profits
SignalBar defaults to 1, meaning signals have a one-bar delay that may miss optimal entry timing
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，替代固定点数，使策略自适应不同品种波动率
增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线方向），避免在震荡市中频繁交易
增加点差/滑点过滤，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit instead of fixed points, making the strategy adaptive to different instrument volatilities
Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Add spread/slippage filtering to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 无点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
固定止损止盈不适应所有品种波动特性
多参数系统存在过拟合风险，回测表现可能无法复现
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: No spread filter mechanism, unfavorable fills possible in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not adapt to volatility characteristics of all instruments
Multi-parameter system carries overfitting risk, backtest performance may not be reproducible
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate position opening
